title: Yap voice dictation for macOS
excerpt: Yap turns speech into text anywhere you can type, entirely on your Mac. No account, no API key, no audio leaving your machine. Free and open source, built by Frigade.
content_html:
Yap

Fast, private, open-source

dictation for macOS.

On-device

Runs on Apple's on-device Speech framework. Nothing to download.

One shortcut

Press to start, press to stop. Rebind it to any key you like.

Pastes anywhere

Text lands in whatever field you were in, terminal to browser.

Private by default

No account, no API key, no telemetry. Audio never leaves your Mac.

Local history

Every transcript is saved on your Mac, searchable and ready to reuse.

Works offline

No network code at all. Dictate on a plane with no signal.

Why we built Yap

We yap all day at Frigade

Mostly for prompting coding agents, writing emails, and firing off Slack messages. Nothing out there was fast and private enough, so we built Yap for ourselves and open sourced it.

Explore Frigade

content_html_zh:
Yap

快速、私有、开源

macOS 听写。

设备上

在 Apple 的设备上语音框架上运行。 没什么可下载的。

一条捷径

按开始，按停止。 将其重新绑定到您喜欢的任何键。

粘贴到任何地方

文本会出现在您所在的任何领域，从终端到浏览器。

默认为私有

没有帐户，没有 API 密钥，没有遥测。 音频永远不会离开您的 Mac。

当地历史

每个成绩单都保存在您的 Mac 上，可搜索并可供重复使用。

离线工作

根本没有网络代码。 在没有信号的飞机上听写。

我们为何建造 Yap

我们在Frigade整天大喊大叫

主要用于提示编码代理、编写电子邮件和发送 Slack 消息。 没有什么是足够快速和私密的，所以我们为自己构建了 Yap 并将其开源。
